definition_text: ARR is the annual value of subscription contracts; Adobe shifted current disclosure to Total Adobe ARR across Creative & Marketing Professionals and Business Professionals & Consumers, adjusted primarily for exchange rates.
included_items: Subscription contracts and ETLA/subscription-service annual value where disclosed.
excluded_items: Not GAAP revenue, deferred revenue, or RPO.
comparability_warning: Adobe ARR framing changed from Digital Media ARR to Total Adobe ARR/customer-group ARR; compare definitions before using as a time series.

definition_text: RPO is future contracted revenue not yet recognized; cRPO is the portion expected over the next 12 months.
included_items: Unearned revenue plus unbilled future contract amounts.
excluded_items: Not ARR; affected by contract and billing structure.
comparability_warning: Backlog is useful but not clean ARR; renewals, duration, FX, acquisitions, and consumption products affect comparability.

definition_text: RPO is contracted revenue not yet recognized; cRPO is RPO expected to be recognized as revenue in the next 12 months.
included_items: Deferred revenue plus non-cancellable future amounts to be invoiced and recognized later.
excluded_items: Billed-in-arrears contracts using the right-to-invoice practical expedient.
comparability_warning: RPO/cRPO varies with FX, offering mix, start dates, renewals, and duration; not equivalent to bookings or ARR.

definition_text: NRR captures expansion/retention; RPO is contracted future revenue excluding on-demand arrangements without minimum commitments.
included_items: Deferred revenue and non-cancelable contracted amounts that will be invoiced and recognized later.
excluded_items: On-demand arrangements without minimum purchase commitments and certain billed-in-arrears time/materials contracts.
comparability_warning: Consumption timing is at customer discretion; RPO is not a clean forward product-revenue proxy.

definition_text: ARR includes expected next-12-month revenue from commitments and, for direct-sales Atlas, annualizes prior 90 days of actual usage; self-serve annualizes prior 30 days.
included_items: Contractual commitments plus annualized recent Atlas/self-serve usage.
comparability_warning: Usage annualization makes ARR sensitive to recent consumption and not directly comparable with pure contracted ARR.

definition_text: Free cash flow is net cash provided by operating activities less capital expenditures and capitalized software development costs, if any.
included_items: Operating cash flow less capex and capitalized software development costs.
excluded_items: Non-GAAP measure, not a substitute for GAAP cash-flow analysis.
comparability_warning: FCF definitions differ by company, especially capitalized software treatment.
